_meta.title: Feminicide victims by state, Mexico, 2015-2025
_meta.what: Number of women recorded as victims of feminicide (the legal crime of killing a woman for gender reasons) in investigations opened by state prosecutors, by state and year, with age group, means (weapon) and month.
_meta.source: Secretariado Ejecutivo del Sistema Nacional de Seguridad Pública (SESNSP), Incidencia delictiva estatal, Fuero común - Víctimas, 2015-2025 (metodología 2015-2025), file Estatal-Víctimas-2015-2025_sep2026
_meta.licence: Términos de Libre Uso MX (Mexican government open data licence): free use including commercial, cite the source
_meta.boundaries: geoBoundaries gbOpen MEX ADM1 (source INEGI, CC BY 3.0 IGO), simplified
_meta.citation: SESNSP, Incidencia delictiva del fuero común, víctimas, 2015-2025, datos abiertos, https://www.gob.mx/sesnsp/acciones-y-programas/datos-abiertos-de-incidencia-delictiva (accessed 2026-10-21)
_meta.notes: Counts as published, summed from monthly figures over all means and age groups. value = 2025 total. These are victims in opened investigations, not convictions; states differ in how often they classify killings of women as feminicide, so low numbers can reflect under-classification. No rate is given because SESNSP does not publish one in this file.
